title: Roof Replacement in Beavercreek, OR
summary: In June 2025, French Roofing replaced the shingle roof on a home in Beavercreek, OR. The crew tore the old roof off down to the deck, swapped in new plywood where the deck needed it, laid Safeguard 30 hybrid underlayment, and installed new CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles with new ridge cap and pipe flashings.
scope: Tore off the old shingles down to the roof deck
Replaced sections of roof deck with new plywood
Installed Safeguard 30 hybrid underlayment over the deck
Installed new drip edge, starter shingles and CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles
New ridge cap and new flashing boots around the plumbing vent pipes
